title: Bundle Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement
brief: Analyze telemetry to measure which bundles worked and which underperformed. Refine bundles based on real usage data. Establish feedback loop for continuous improvement. Quantitative target: >=90% product-critical engines active in normal workflows.

units.title: Analyze bundle telemetry: activation frequency, success rate, capability utilization per bundle
Identify underperforming bundles: low activation, low success, unused capabilities
Refine bundles based on telemetry: add missing capabilities, remove unused, rebalance
Establish closed feedback loop: telemetry -> analysis -> refinement -> re-measurement cycle

exit_conditions: Bundle telemetry analyzed with quantitative findings
>=90% product-critical engines active in normal workflows
notes: Gap fix — closed feedback loop added to ensure continuous improvement after initial deployment
